purpose: Provide one explicit registry for keyboard shortcuts across Structure tools without embedding shortcut ownership into semantic CW data.
invariants: Every shortcut has a stable id, key chord, owner and action id.
Shortcut key chords MUST be unique within the same active context.
Shortcuts MUST NOT fire while focus is inside input, textarea, select or contenteditable controls unless explicitly declared for that context.
Shortcut actions operate only through their owning tool API/state and MUST NOT create semantic evidence.
The Shortcut Registry is UI/runtime configuration and is not part of CW semantics.
Forward and reverse cycling actions MUST wrap around when the target collection is non-empty.
